description: Read a client's LinkedIn access checklist: authenticator key in BAMF Vault, LinkedIn login on BAMF Cloud, Multilogin profile, BAMF Connect, LinkedIn posting OAuth, and the detected LinkedIn plan (Sales Navigator green, other plans amber with the upgrade link). Agency owner/admin only; API keys need the client_access:read scope. Never returns secrets.

client.description: Client workspace id, slug, or client name (a client of an agency you own or admin).

name: bamf.get_client_access
